title: test(objectql,driver-sql): platform pins replacing hotcrm's platform-semantics tests (#15953 engine rows 3, 4-5, 7, 8, 10, 11)
body:
Fixes #23603

Clause-②: no

Part of the #15953 family split (engine rows). Each row of #23603 lands as a platform test in its own package, pinning the semantics the hotcrm file pins, with one ablation per row. Each row names the hotcrm file it lets hotcrm retire under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1583. Test-only: no source line changes, and no changeset (`skip-changeset`).

## Rows

hotcrm files were read at objectstack-ai/hotcrm `63db83e` (read-only clone). The ablations ran on this branch at `c0aa01086c`, before the `main` merge, which touches none of the files below. Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` and was restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.

| row | new test file | hotcrm file it retires (#1583) | ablation: mutated function → red line |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 3 | `packages/objectql/src/engine-referential-required-lookup-default-restrict.test.ts` | `test/line-item-cascade.test.ts` (R residue: the escalation) | `ObjectQL.walkReferencingRelations` (engine.ts), the escalation `if (requiredSetNull && !multiValued)` disabled → red at `:131`. The delete answers the dependent's own `Deal is required` ValidationError instead of `DELETE_RESTRICTED` / 409. |
| 4-5 | `packages/objectql/src/engine-referential-clear-write-context.test.ts` | `test/lead-duplicate-link-cleanup.test.ts` and `test/freeze-guard-reference-cleanup.test.ts` (R residues: the cleanup write and its context table) | `ObjectQL.walkReferencingRelations`: `...(context ?? {})` dropped from the `referentialCtx` spread → red at `:159`, `:160` and `:178` (the identity is no longer inherited, and the cascade no longer matches the hand-clear). The identity-less row stays green, as predicted. |
| 7 | `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-legacy-tenant-composite-null-distinct.test.ts` | `test/case-number-tenant-scope.test.ts` (R residue: "the OLD table-composite spelling constrained nothing untenanted") | `uniqueIndexesFromFields` (schema-drift.ts): `nullSafeColumns` dropped → red at `:73` (no `COALESCE` key part) and `:88` (an untenanted duplicate is admitted). The old-spelling half stays green, as predicted. |
| 8 | `packages/objectql/src/engine-readonly-update-strip-system-gate.test.ts` | `test/readonly-write-semantics.test.ts` (the caller-PATCH and hook-stamp describes) | `ObjectQL.update`: `staticReadonlyStripRuns = !opCtx.context?.isSystem` forced to `true` → red at `:114`, in the two `isSystem` contexts. |
| 10 | `packages/objectql/src/engine-undeclared-key-caller-path.test.ts` | `test/undeclared-key-probe.test.ts` (half 1, the caller path) | `undeclaredWriteFieldErrors` (engine.ts): the door returns no errors → red at `:104`, `:114` and `:122`. Both controls stay green. |
| 11 | `packages/objectql/src/engine-filter-token-today-spelling.test.ts` | `test/flow-filter-today-token.test.ts` (the two query-layer PREMISE cases) | `resolveFilterTokens` (`@objectstack/core` `utils/filter-tokens.ts`): an `unknown` token passes through instead of throwing → red at `:74` and `:116`. objectql resolves `@objectstack/core` through `dist/`, so the run was mutate → rebuild core → `ablation-dist-preflight` (marker in 2 built files) → red → restore → rebuild → preflight `--absent` with a clean tree → 4/4 green. |

Not in this PR, as the card and the dispatch say:
- Row 10's dogfood driver-conformance half stays on #15953.
- Row 11's service-automation half is its own card. It landed on `main` in `534ca13eb5` while this branch was open, and it complements these tests without overlapping them.
- Row 8's flow-writer (`runAs`) describes also belong to service-automation.

## Verification record

**Each new file alone:** green. The five objectql files run 24 tests together, with 317 ms of test body and the rest spent importing `engine.ts`, which every objectql test file pays. The driver-sql file runs 9 tests in 69 ms.

**Suites and typecheck at `6e62264e` (pre-gate-fix):**
- `@objectstack/objectql`: 432 files / 8172 tests passed.
- `@objectstack/driver-sql`: 221 files passed, 11 skipped (3668 tests passed, 208 skipped).
- Both `typecheck` scripts exit 0. objectql's includes `check:test-typecheck`, and the new files add no debt: still 39 files / 233 errors in `test-typecheck-debt.json`. driver-sql's `tsc --listFiles` includes the new file.

**Gate fixes after the first derived-gate run:**
- `check:objectql-double-limit`: the new driver doubles now apply the caller's `limit`.
- `check:where-matcher`: two matchers now refuse a `$` combinator instead of reading it as a field.
- `check:query-options-erasure`: three `as any` query bags are now typed `EngineQueryOptions` / `EngineCountOptions`, and the test surface is back at 236.

All three exit 0 at `c0aa01086c`, and objectql `typecheck` (with `check:test-typecheck`) is OK there.

**On the final head, after merging `main` (`4245e2660d`):**
- One `os-verify-lock` run of objectql `test`, driver-sql `test`, objectql `typecheck` (with `check:test-typecheck` OK) and driver-sql `typecheck`, joined with `&&`, returned `VERDICT command-exit 0`. objectql: 432 files / 8172 tests. driver-sql: 221 passed, 11 skipped.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` was re-derived with no paths (no stale-tree warning; 861 changed lines). All 54 derived commands exit 0.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 54 derived, 54 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: every entry records its exit code). The run reads git history and built output, so the clone was unshallowed and the closure built first.

## Acceptance notes

**Overlap with existing pins.** The card's ruling is that each row lands as its own test, but several rows were already partly pinned on `main`. Each new file pins the hotcrm-shaped facts the existing ones did not:
- Row 3 adds the spec-parsed premise (a bare required lookup resolves to `set_null`), "no write reaches the dependent", and parent-keyed cascade. The existing pins are `engine-cascade-delete.test.ts` #9625 and #13644.
- Rows 4-5 add the `{ id, LINK: null }` payload, hotcrm's three-caller context table, "the referenced record is still readable", and "a refusing holder hook refuses the delete". The existing pins are `engine-cascade-delete.test.ts` #3023 and #13644.
- Row 8 adds the three-context matrix. The existing pins are `engine-readonly-strip-caller-values.test.ts` and its siblings.
- Row 10 adds the declared-elsewhere control. The existing pins are `engine-undeclared-field-preflight.test.ts` and `engine-undeclared-update-field.test.ts`.
- Row 11 adds `{today}`'s boundary row (a row dated today is excluded) and the resolver called directly. The existing pin is `engine-filter-tokens.test.ts` #5586.
- Row 7 adds the reverse verification: the old composite, in both its bare-`true` and `'global'` spellings, admits an untenanted duplicate. The existing pin is `sql-driver-unique-tenancy.test.ts`.

**Driver doubles.** Each file carries its own stub driver, per the claim's "fixture helper inside the new test file".

**Clock.** The engine-path `{today}` case computes its fixture dates at run time. A run that straddles UTC midnight between the fixture write and the query could misread, which is the same exposure hotcrm's case had. The resolver case is pinned to a fixed `now`.
